date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: Selected non-container rail imports were suspended from 28 November 2021, with permission for iron ore, coal and bagged goods in open wagons from 27 January 2022. This is a 60-day policy-date difference. An ore train was reported to have recently arrived by 7 February; its exact first arrival day remains unknown. EA029 concerns the separate China-to-Mongolia road-freight phase; its December dates are not rail endpoints. Container traffic and other commodity restoration dates are not generalised.
